groups.title: Area charts
groups.summary: A volume over time: a 2px line over a quiet fill. One series is ink; several take the data colours and a key.

charts.title: Interactive
charts.note: A period switch in the head of the card.

charts.title: Step
charts.note: For a value that holds until it changes.

charts.title: Peak labelled
charts.note: The extreme named in the plot.

charts.title: Stacked
charts.note: Parts of a whole over time.

groups.title: Bar charts
groups.summary: Separate periods, rankings and parts of a whole: bars 24px wide at most, with 4px corners at the end that carries the value.

charts.title: Interactive
charts.note: A channel switch in the head of the card.

charts.title: Peak labelled
charts.note: A value axis, and the extreme named.

charts.title: Ranking
charts.note: Horizontal bars, sorted, every value written.

charts.title: Stacked
charts.note: Parts of a whole, set apart by a gap.

charts.title: Negative values
charts.note: Bars grow from zero in both directions.

charts.title: One bar picked out
charts.note: The subject in ink, the rest as context.

groups.title: Line charts
groups.summary: A trend: 2px lines, no dots unless each reading matters. Never a second value axis.

charts.title: Step
charts.note: For a count that holds until it changes.

charts.title: Two series
charts.note: The first two data colours and a key.

charts.title: Peak labelled
charts.note: The extreme named in the plot.

charts.title: Dashed comparison
charts.note: The subject in ink, last season dashed in grey.

groups.title: Pie charts
groups.summary: Parts of a whole at one moment, five at most, clockwise from the top and set apart by a gap.

charts.title: Donut
charts.note: A thin ring with the total in the middle.

charts.title: Active part
charts.note: The middle names the part under the pointer.

groups.title: Radar charts
groups.summary: Several measures of one thing, on a hairline web. Two series at most.

charts.title: Outlines
charts.note: No fill, where shapes cover each other.

groups.title: Radial charts
groups.summary: A single share or score as a ring on a track, with its figure in the middle.

charts.title: Rings
charts.note: A ring for each of a few things.

charts.title: Gauge
charts.note: Half a ring from empty to full.

groups.title: Tooltips
groups.summary: What the tooltip can say. Each is shown open; point at another bar to move it.

charts.title: Default
charts.note: The category, then each series with its swatch.

charts.title: Line mark
charts.note: A line instead of a swatch.

charts.title: Own first line
charts.note: The category written by a formatter.

charts.title: Total
charts.note: A last row sums the series.

groups.title: The Chart component
groups.summary: One component for the six usual forms: give it labels and series, and it composes the chart, its key and its table of figures.

charts.title: Donut and its key
charts.note: type="donut" side: the key sits beside the ring when the card has room.
